basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old living in Bengaluru, India, currently working as a junior software developer. I've always had a passion for technology, but I'm relatively new to the professional scene and still learning the ropes. In my free time, I enjoy exploring quantum physics concepts and watching British sci-fi series like Torchwood. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM IST. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends attending tech meetups or watching documentaries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been self-teaching various programming languages through online courses and tutorials. My job as a junior developer has exposed me to real-world coding challenges, but I'm still building confidence in troubleshooting and hardware issues.
